RWE-0843.summary: Public-health component implementing CDC Socrata queries and WHO Global Health Observatory indicator retrieval.
capabilities: Query CDC Socrata datasets with filters and pagination
Retrieve WHO health indicators by country and year
RWE-0843.limitation: Selected source implements three CDC/WHO tools, despite conflicting repository-root and example-dataset descriptions. CDC pages are capped at 200 with offset; WHO indicator responses are capped at 200 without pagination. Verify dataset IDs, currency, coverage and definitions. No runtime testing.

RWE-0845.summary: Academic Research component for scholarly search, publication metadata and citation chaining across PubMed, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv and OpenCitations.

RWE-0851.summary: Scientific-tool gateway with a documented scholarly-search component spanning PubMed, Europe PMC and other literature sources.
capabilities: Connect research agents through MCP tool selection
Access broader scientific tools outside the retained literature scope

RWE-0202.summary: Clinical-calculator server documenting severity, risk and outcome instruments, retained for structured research-variable calculation.
capabilities: Discover calculator schemas and cited formula references
Calculate documented severity and risk scores
Calculate named outcome instruments including modified Rankin Scale
RWE-0202.limitation: Retained scope is research-variable measurement, not clinical recommendations. Formula implementation, input definitions and suitability for each study require independent validation.

RWE-0240.summary: Precision Medicine platform retained for its specific mcp-epic FHIR clinical-data retrieval component.
capabilities: Retrieve patient demographics and conditions from an authorized Epic FHIR endpoint
Retrieve observations filtered by category or LOINC code
RWE-0240.limitation: Real endpoint access requires local hospital credentials. EPIC_DRY_RUN and mcp-mockepic return synthetic data. De-identification and production-readiness claims were not independently validated; the broader molecular and clinical decision-support tools are outside this retained scope.
